title: Portal Cycle Homestead Anchor
notes: PORTAL-CYCLE-001: All realm transitions via portals preserve the original farm as the return anchor. Crossing any portal records the entry wing and position; exit always resolves to FARM_START on wing 0 unless a pinned farm rack seed is active.

Guaranteed return: even if the cross fade is interrupted, placeCourtSpawn forces return to the upper farmland. Source: internal engine contract in content.ts placeCourtSpawn and logic.ts sideGate returns.

Occult depth: portals are not mere gates but cycles of departure and return, echoing the Vedic concept of lokas as temporary sojourns. Sourced: Bhagavata Purana descriptions of Svarga and Naraka as non-permanent realms.
